meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 本技能给 NanoClaw 加上 WhatsApp 频道:从 channels 分支复制原生 Baileys 适配器和 whatsapp-formatting 技能、注册适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,最后用扫码或配对码完成设备关联。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 支持,或要重新关联号码时触发。安装或认证前会先做号码安全检查:若选了共享/个人号,会先弹出账号可能被停用或封禁的风险警告。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 会先问用专用号还是共享号
终端显示二维码,约 20 秒刷新一次

say.text: 我要用现有的个人 WhatsApp 号
say.note: 会先弹出账号风险警告,需你确认

howto.what_en: Adds a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw: copies the native Baileys adapter and WhatsApp formatting skill from the channels branch, registers it, installs deps, builds, runs the registration test, then links the device by QR or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add WhatsApp support to NanoClaw or re-link a number. A required number safety check runs first; choosing a shared/personal number shows an account-ban risk warning.

say_en.note: It first asks dedicated vs shared number

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: A QR appears in the terminal, refreshing every ~20s

say_en.text: I want to use my everyday personal number
say_en.note: It shows the account-risk warning first
